# telnyx_10dlc_campaign_builder_brand_usecase (Data Source)

Whether a 10DLC brand qualifies for a campaign use case, with the use case's fees and the number of sub-use cases it requires. Check this before creating a campaign.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `brand_id` (String) The brand.
- `usecase` (String) Campaign usecase

### Read-Only

- `annual_fee` (Number) Campaign annual subscription fee
- `max_sub_usecases` (Number) Maximum number of sub-usecases declaration required.
- `min_sub_usecases` (Number) Minimum number of sub-usecases declaration required.
- `mno_metadata` (String) Map of usecase metadata for each MNO. Key is the network ID of the MNO (e.g. 10017), Value is the mno metadata for the usecase. A JSON document; use `jsondecode()` to read it.
- `monthly_fee` (Number) Campaign monthly subscription fee
- `quarterly_fee` (Number) Campaign quarterly subscription fee
